snippet.title: Snow Panic - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Announcement Trailer for Snow Panic, a multiplayer chaotic online ski racing game developed by KAFI. Players will hurl themselves down a snowy mountain at top speeds to win the race. Keep speeds high, avoid the dangerous wildlife, and make use of weaponry to take out rivals. Snow Panic is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
